# Quantum Success, Blueprint to Freedom

> Online personal development education and individual coaching, founded by Dr Hemani Chaturvedi. Headquartered in Australia. The learning covers lifestyle, personal growth, vitality and leadership, through a self-paced curriculum with lifetime access and one-to-one online coaching.

Quantum Success is a home for growth-minded people ready for more freedom, purpose and impact. It is voluntary personal development education and coaching: it is not medical or psychological treatment, counselling or a diagnostic service.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.quantumsuccessblueprint.com/): what Quantum Success is, the Foundation programme, the free 7-day online bootcamp and reflections from learners
- [About Dr Hemani Chaturvedi](https://www.quantumsuccessblueprint.com/about/): the founder, the promise and why people choose Quantum Success
- [Enrol and engage](https://www.quantumsuccessblueprint.com/choose-your-blueprint/): the Foundation, Intermediate and Advanced levels and how to enrol
- [Videos and reflections](https://www.quantumsuccessblueprint.com/videos/): short reflections from Hemani and her LinkedIn and Instagram posts
- [Contact](https://www.quantumsuccessblueprint.com/contact-us/): book a complimentary Deep Dive conversation or send an enquiry

## Programmes

- Foundation level: 17 foundational modules (17 days, about 1 hour each), 8 immersion modules (2 weeks, about 2 hours each), 5 individual online coaching sessions with Dr Hemani Chaturvedi (45 minutes each), actionable strategies and reflective exercises, lifetime access, self-paced.
- Intermediate level: deeper transformational learning modules, practical exercises and guided reflections, online coaching sessions, lifetime access.
- Advanced level: premium experiences with transformational learning, world-class speakers and meaningful connections, in person or online.
